title: Nocturne operator nullification decisions
description: Decisions that strike artwork, or artwork and its rendering outputs, from the final contract. Keys are exact strings, whitespace included. A historical-definition key is a definitionId of native/evidence/artwork-inventory-20261031/INVENTORY.json and strikes every instance of that definition. A historical-instance key is the instance's file#locator#identifier; where that names more than one instance (a palette and a composite on one line), append #<kind>. A current-identity key is a native/catalogue.json id and strikes its catalogue entry, its native/port-ledger.json entry, the recipes and Gallery studies that name it, its component captures and its catalogue documentation. A rendering-output key is recipe:<native/recipes.json id> or capture:<component>/<state> of docs/current/images/CAPTURES.json. Each (scope, key) pair occurs once, every key must resolve, and no string may hold a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 form; native/scripts/nullification.py enforces all three, which JSON Schema cannot express. Nullification deletes nothing from the native core, its fixtures or evidence; removal from the core is a later, separately qualified step (native/docs/NULLIFICATION.md).

decidedAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time with seconds and a UTC offset, as Date.prototype.toISOString() writes it.
